summary: Sleepy Hollow RV Park (Portola): kept - $35/night full hookups on the operator page (dated April 2020; passes the price gate), phone booking, cash/check; year-round; no restrooms/showers; Google 3.9 (30); nightly share unmeasured, reviews show overnight guests.
flags: LONG-STAY TEST: the operator posts nightly, weekly and monthly rates ($35/night, $295 + electricity a month). Nightly share not measurable (no site map or booking engine); Google reviews describe overnight and short stays, and imagery shows only a few rigs on the loop. Google 3.9 (30 reviews). Kept.
PRICE: $35/night passes the $50 gate, but the rate is dated 'Prices effective April 1 2020' (the home page still says $30) - stale; no newer rate found. Flag for a call if a current figure matters.
